en: Colorized vintage view of a tree-lined avenue in a park. A wide path runs through tall trees on the right, with dense green foliage forming a canopy. On the left is a grassy slope with bushes and a small wooden fence or railing, and a side path curving uphill. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century color postcard. At the bottom center, red printed text identifies the location as 'Freiberg i. S. KönigsaIlee.'
